About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 


 Job Description: AI Engineer – Generative AI & Product Engineering 
 Role Overview 
 We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with strong product development experience to design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate combines expertise in LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, Python, Azure, and cloud-native engineering with a product mindset focused on scalability, reliability, security, and user experience.
 The engineer will work across the full product lifecycle, from architecture and prototyping through API development, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and production support.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop enterprise Generative AI and agentic AI applications using LangChain/LangSmith and LangGraph .
 Build multi-step and stateful AI workflows involving reasoning, tool integration, retrieval, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
 Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using PostgreSQL and pgvector for vector storage and semantic retrieval.
 Integrate applications with Azure OpenAI and other LLM-based services.
 Design effective prompts and reusable prompt patterns using advanced prompt engineering techniques.
 Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI .
 Develop evaluation and observability mechanisms for measuring AI response quality, latency, reliability, and retrieval effectiveness.
 Use LangSmith for tracing, evaluation, debugging, and observability of LLM/agent workflows.
 Containerize and deploy AI services to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) .
 Design solutions using appropriate Azure services for identity, security, networking, storage, monitoring, and application integration.
 Implement production-ready practices including exception handling, logging, retries, API security, configuration management, and observability.
 Work closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to convert business requirements into scalable AI product capabilities.
 Participate in architecture/design reviews, code reviews, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and ongoing product enhancement.
 Evaluate emerging LLM, retrieval, agentic AI, and AI engineering techniques and apply them where they provide measurable product value.
 Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, database, and operations teams during major incidents and production issues to identify dependencies and resolve problems.
 Required Technical Skills 
 Generative AI 
 Large Language Models (LLMs)
 Azure OpenAI
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 Prompt Engineering
 Agentic AI / AI Agents
 LLM evaluation and observability
 AI Frameworks 
 LangChain
 LangGraph
 LangSmith
 Application Engineering 
 Python
 FastAPI
 REST APIs
 Async/API development
 Microservices architecture
 Data & Vector Search 
 PostgreSQL
 pgvector
 Vector embeddings
 Semantic/vector search
 RAG retrieval and indexing patterns
 Cloud & Deployment 
 Microsoft Azure
 Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
 Containers/Docker
 Cloud-native application development
 CI/CD and production deployment practices
 Product Development Experience 
 The candidate should demonstrate experience taking AI capabilities beyond proof-of-concept into production products , including:
 Translating business requirements into technical product capabilities
 Designing reusable and maintainable AI architectures
 Balancing model quality, latency, cost, security, and scalability
 Designing APIs and integration patterns for enterprise applications
 Establishing AI evaluation and quality measures
 Troubleshooting production LLM/RAG applications
 Collaborating across engineering, architecture, product, QA, DevOps, and business teams
 Owning features through design, development, testing, deployment, and production stabilization
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise GenAI/RAG products 
 Experience building LangGraph-based agentic workflows 
 Hands-on experience with LangSmith tracing and evaluation 
 Experience deploying Python/FastAPI applications on AKS 
 Experience with PostgreSQL/pgvector at production scale
 Understanding of LLM hallucination, grounding, context management, guardrails, and evaluation
 Familiarity with Azure identity, secrets management, monitoring, and enterprise security patterns
 Experience building internal developer, infrastructure, automation, operations, or knowledge-management AI products is a plus.
 
 Salary Range:
$80,800 - 133,400 USD 
 Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component. 

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa). 

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
